payout_quote: Approved recipients can receive matching scholarships of tuition units worth up to $2,000 at today's prices, while top-scoring recipients also can receive a one-time grant of tuition units worth $3,000 at today's prices.
steps: Confirm the child's eligibility (Texas Tuition Promise Fund beneficiary, grades 3-9, Texas resident, family income $120,000 or less).
Read the Matching Scholarship and Tuition Grant Description and Application Instructions.
Have the child research a career and write the student career essay; obtain the prior school year's report card or transcript.
Apply online at MatchThePromise.org (or by mail) between September 1 and December 31.
If approved, submit the federal tax return for income verification by May 31 and ensure at least $50 in contributions to the Promise Fund contract during the sales period (Sept 1-Aug 31).
catches: Competitive, not guaranteed: applications are scored on grade averages, income levels, and number of dependents; only approved recipients receive awards.
Grades 3-9 only; Texas resident; family income $120,000 or less; the child must be a Texas Tuition Promise Fund (prepaid tuition plan) beneficiary.
Awards are tuition units, not cash - deposited to a Foundation-owned scholarship account and disbursed directly to Texas public colleges for undergraduate resident tuition and required fees only.
At least $50 in Promise Fund contributions during the sales period (September 1-August 31) is required to receive an award.
Must reapply each year; the Promise (tuition grant) scholarship can be received only once.
Non-qualified use of 529 funds carries federal income tax on earnings plus a 10% federal penalty - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: Competitive and not guaranteed - applications are scored, and even winners receive tuition units (not cash) locked to undergraduate tuition and fees at Texas public colleges.
eligibility: Texas resident student in grades 3-9 who is a Texas Tuition Promise Fund beneficiary and the tax dependent of a Texas resident, with family income of $120,000 or less.
timing: Annual cycle: applications September 1-December 31; approvals notified in April; minimum contributions due by August 31; scholarship units deposited by end of September.
payout_value_note: Tuition units, not cash; up to $2,000 match; top scorers may also get a one-time $3,000 tuition-unit grant.
numeric_basis: payout from official Comptroller terms (up to $2,000 in tuition units); time: application + child career essay + gathering report card/transcript, est. 30-60 min active.
